mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 115 indicates robust economic activity, typically resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 115.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand for housing, typically leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in INDPRO signals monetary easing coupled with strong production, typically producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and INDPRO rises above 115.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 200), rising inflation and higher rates typically cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts index (HOUST) above 1700 signals robust consumer demand, typically driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1700.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment (PAYEMS) increase above 135,000 thousand signals strong job growth, typically resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 135000.
